title: Add sentiment word lists and loader
description:
Create patterns/sentiment-words.yaml with versioned sections for the gratitude family (thanks, thank you, thx, ty, cheers, appreciate(d), grateful, and similar) and the F-bomb family (the base token and its inflections, enumerated explicitly — no stemming guesses). Add a loader mirroring the existing classifier config loader style, with user override via the personal config file.

Done when: the YAML loads and validates; the meter reads its lists from data, not code; overriding the list path in config works.
